defect.summary: All four agent hook surfaces stored SessionStart commands under a non-standard top-level key uos_control_loop.PreInvocation. Claude Code reads 'hooks'; that key was never read, so the hooks had never fired on any surface.
defect.prior_claim_corrected: 'wired on three surfaces' was overstated: the payload was tested, the wiring was not.

schema_migration: uos_control_loop.PreInvocation[] -> hooks.SessionStart[].hooks[]. Output shape on the two Claude surfaces aligned to .codex/hooks.json (hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) so the advisory reaches the model rather than only the user display. .agents/.gemini command payloads preserved byte-for-byte.

installed_client_validation.method: Real invocation of the installed client binary, not manual command execution.
installed_client_validation.probe: a temporary sentinel command appended to the same hooks.SessionStart array, then 'claude -p' run non-interactively in the target cwd; sentinel file inspected; sentinel removed afterwards.

runs.why: proves the loader executes every entry in the array, not only the first

installed_client_validation.not_validated_reason: Those clients were not started here. Their schema was migrated to the shape .codex and .claude both use, and their command payloads were pipe-tested and preserved byte-for-byte, but no running .agents/.gemini client was observed loading them. UNVALIDATED, not passing.
installed_client_validation.residue_check: no 'hook-fired' string remains in any settings file

legacy_shell_parser_repair.defect: top-level receipt fields were extracted with an unanchored greedy sed expression. On a single-line receipt the leading .* matches the LAST occurrence, i.e. the final ROW's status. A receipt whose top-level status was FAIL reported PASS whenever its last row happened to be PASS.
legacy_shell_parser_repair.fix: anchored every top-level extraction to the JSON prologue, plus a fail-closed guard that refuses an unparseable receipt instead of falling through to a comparison that silently succeeds

regression_tests.case: PASS receipt whose LAST row is FAIL
receipt written in a drifted format (pretty-printed)

legacy_shell_parser_repair.defect_class: an observable coarser than the property being enforced - the same class this review has been reporting throughout
